en.t: The day of departure was already tomorrow.

units.source_text: 今天夜间，源氏公子当前往拜别桐壶院之墓，便向北山出发。

en.t: That night, Prince Genji was to go and bid farewell at the grave of the Kiritsubo Emperor, then set out for Kitayama.

units.source_text: 其时将近破晓，月色当空。

en.t: By then dawn was near, and the moonlight hung high in the sky.

units.source_text: 拜墓时刻尚早，便先去参谒师姑藤壶皇后。

en.t: Since it was still too early to visit the grave, he first went to pay his respects to his aunt, Empress Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 皇后在近身的帘前安排源氏公子的座位，隔帘亲自和他谈话。

en.t: The Empress had a seat prepared for Prince Genji near the curtain beside her and spoke with him herself through the screen.

units.source_text: 皇后首先提及皇太子，对他的未来表示深切的关怀。

en.t: The Empress first spoke of the Crown Prince and showed deep concern for his future.

units.source_text: 这两人胸中秘藏着共同的心事，其谈话自然含有无限深情。

en.t: Because these two secretly carried the same matter in their hearts, their conversation naturally held boundless feeling.

units.source_text: 皇后容貌之美，不减当年。

en.t: The Empress's beauty had not diminished since former days.

units.source_text: 源氏公子往日受她冷遇，今日颇思对她略申怨恨之情。

en.t: Remembering how coldly she had treated him in the past, Prince Genji rather wished today to express a little of his resentment to her.

units.source_text: 转念今日重提旧事，未免使她伤心，自己亦更增烦恼，便隐忍不言，但说：

en.t: But thinking again that raising old matters today would inevitably grieve her and only increase his own distress, he endured it in silence and merely said:

units.source_text: “我身蒙此意外之罪，实因有一背叛良心之事，不胜惶恐。

en.t: "That I have incurred this unexpected offense is truly because there was something in which I betrayed my conscience, and I am overcome with fear and shame.

units.source_text: 我身诚不足惜，但望太子顺利即位，于愿足矣。”

en.t: My own person is really not worth regretting; I only hope that the Crown Prince will ascend the throne smoothly, and that will fully satisfy my wish."
